source.title: Competency-based education for CBSE — Item Bank: Maths Class 8 (September 2021)
source.subject: mathematics
source.authorityName: Central Board of Secondary Education (content created by the British Council)
source.notes: A bank of practice items for teachers (not an examination paper), published by CBSE in September 2021 with content created by the British Council. The introduction says it contains 81 items; the document actually holds 64 item blocks, 8 of which are repeated verbatim (Maths8BS2, BS4, PR6, NB5, PW7, DG6, PW6, DG5), so 56 distinct items are extracted here (each repeat taken once, from its first occurrence). Item Maths8SK4 is listed in the item index but does not appear in the document. Items are identified by their printed reference (e.g. Maths8DB6) because every item is numbered '1' inside its own block; parts (a), (b)… are the printed sub-question labels. Answers come from each item's own mark scheme ('Answer' / 'Guidance'). Several mark schemes restate the question with small differences, and some metadata tables disagree with the marks printed next to the questions; the printed question marks are used and each discrepancy is flagged. Items map to the NCERT books current in 2021; chapters were mapped to the current (Ganita Prakash) syllabus as suggestions and must be confirmed. Topics with no clear home in the current book (volume, nets/Euler's formula, data handling, probability) are left unmapped.
source.usage: Official CBSE item bank, freely available on cbseacademic.nic.in for teachers to use as they wish; question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to the original. Figures are not reproduced.

questions.text: Pizza factory has come out with two kinds of pizzas. A square pizza of side 45 cm costs Rs.150 and a circular pizza of diameter 50 cm costs Rs.160. (Thickness of both the pizzas is same.) Which pizza is a better deal? Use pi = 3.14

officialAnswer.text: Square pizza is a better deal because it has a larger area with lesser cost. M1 Area of a square pizza = 𝑆𝑖𝑑𝑒 × 𝑆𝑖𝑑𝑒 = 45𝑐𝑚 × 45𝑐𝑚 = 2025 𝑐𝑚2; Area of a circular pizza = 𝜋𝑟2 = 3.14 × 25 × 25𝑐𝑚2 = 1962.5𝑐𝑚2; A1: Area of a square pizza is more than the area of a circular pizza. Also, cost of a square pizza is lesser than the cost of a circular pizza. Hence, square pizza is a better deal.
